svg.title: Uniform-pore Ni-rich cathode: cycling data and spatial mechanism
svg.desc: Capacity and voltage retention re-plotted from deposited raw data, followed by a qualitative comparison of less-uniform and uniform pore networks.
svg.text: Uniform-pore Ni-rich cathode: cycling outcome and spatial mechanism
Top: every deposited Fig. 5e capacity and voltage point · Bottom: qualitative mechanism based on Eum et al.

g.aria-label: Shared cycle-number axis for the two quantitative plots

svg.text: Quantitative plots: cycle 1 = 100%; every deposited capacity and voltage point shown. Mechanism panel: conceptual synthesis based on Eum et al.
